en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub, from Abu Ubeyda, 
Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘They came with a woman to Aliasws along with a man who had been immoral with her. So she said, ‘He coerced (forced) me, By Allahazwj, O Amir Al-Momineenasws! So heasws staved off the Penalty (Hadd) from her, and had these (people) been asked about that, they would say, ‘Do not ratify’, and Amir Al-Momineenasws had done it’.
